summary: Iteration 9 — CARD/MOOVCI removal + OTP-optional verified end-to-end. Backend: 30/30 pytest pass (29 offline + 1 live). GET /api/paxity/config returns exactly 5 methods {OMSN, OMCI, WAVESN, WAVECI, MTNCI}, all requires_otp=false, no CARD, no MOOVCI. POST /api/paxity/payin correctly returns 400 'Méthode de paiement inconnue' for CARD/MOOVCI/FOOBAR and 400 'Montant invalide' for amount=0. ONE live OMSN payin with NO otp_code succeeded: HTTP 200, status=pending, payment_link contains 'orange-sonatel', qr_code non-empty, requires_otp=false. Frontend (/commande): method grid shows exactly 5 tiles with no 'Carte bancaire'/'Moov Money' tile; OTP input labeled 'Code OTP (facultatif)' with NO required attribute; submitting OMSN with empty OTP goes straight to pending screen (paxity-payment-link-btn + paxity-qr-code visible, 'Paiement en cours…' + 'Payer maintenant' shown, NO 'Code OTP requis' toast). Payin POST body confirmed to omit otp_code entirely.

issues: Copy still mentions 'Paiement Mobile Money, Carte, PayPal' — 'Carte' is no longer offered by Paxity. Cosmetic only, not blocking, but should be updated for consistency.

seed_data_creation: One real 100 XOF OMSN pending transaction created on the live Paxity account (RUN_LIVE_OMSN=1 gated, ran exactly once as instructed). Frontend submission intercepted with page.route to avoid creating a second real transaction.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by 30 tests split across test_paxity_card_removal.py (config + validation + live OMSN gated by RUN_LIVE_OMSN=1), test_paxity_parsing.py, test_tracking.py, test_paxity_diagnostic_preview.py. To rerun the live OMSN payin: `cd /app/backend && RUN_LIVE_OMSN=1 pytest tests/test_paxity_card_removal.py::TestLiveOMSNNoOTP -v` — creates a real 100 XOF pending tx, use sparingly. Frontend flow: seed sec_cart_v1 in localStorage, /commande → step1 form (placeholders 'Marie','Dupont','marie@exemple.com','Rue, quartier…','Dakar','77 XXX XX XX') → Continuer → Continuer → click 'Orange Money Sénégal' → click submit button matching regex ^Payer\s → intercept /api/paxity/payin with page.route.
rca of the issue: Original user bug (CARD → 400) was actually correct behavior from an infrastructure standpoint (Paxity merchant does not support cards). Fix applied in iteration 9: removed CARD+MOOVCI from PAYMENT_METHODS so the frontend never offers them; flipped requires_otp=false on OMSN/OMCI since Paxity live API is CODE_QR (link/QR pay flow) — OTP is genuinely optional. Testing confirms both branches: the two removed methods now yield 400 'unknown method' if forced, and OMSN succeeds without any OTP.
